## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak overall breadth plus mixed leadership with Utilities/Financials/Real Estate showing strength while Tech is broadly weak. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5), major divergence present — watch for trend breaks.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, CEG noted in news but lacking timeframe here. Financials lead: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, broader Financials positive. Real Estate steady: DLR (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -3.51%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -4.84% | 1M: -12.80%) BELOW TREND. Materials weak: FCX (1W: -8.17% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: TTWO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY, ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, DLR (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical and defensive names both contributing.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: FCX (1W: -8.17% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.52%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -15.96%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology/Materials and select Communications names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: TTWO (1W: +12.21%), WMB (1W: +6.01%), ABBV (1W: +5.94%), VST (1W: +5.93%), DLR (1W: +5.46%). Major divergence flagged (≥3 notable names with 1W ≠ 1M such as FCX, UNH, LLY) — tactical moves, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is weak with heavy mega-cap selling: MSFT (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -5.47% (24 stocks) indicating broad pressure. Expect continued selectivity; watch LRCX/AVGO news for pockets of strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are a relative leader: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND and other banks showing resilience; Financials 1W: +1.17% (20 stocks). Style: Value/cyclical tilt within Financials but overall breadth remains mixed.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed but stable: ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +7.61%) CORRECTION. Sentiment and M&A/FDA headlines are driving idiosyncratic moves; monitor AMGN legal headlines for downside risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and select defensive cyclicals (JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to broad mega-cap Tech that remains BELOW TREND (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL). Major divergence and low breadth argue for selective positioning and waiting for confirmation on trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -18.45%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth positive, 1W: +1.17%) and Utilities (VST ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -5.47%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.77%) — monitor for further dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
JPM 1W momentum continuation above recent intraday highs may extend trend (JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND). NVDA needs 1W reversal back above recent resistance to exit BELOW TREND (NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND). ORCL downside follow-through would confirm bearish sentiment (ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVX (+60): Chevron (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -7.87%) BELOW TREND — bullish contract news but price diverging on weaker 1M. XOM (+55): Exxon (1W: -0.84% | 1M: -10.02%) BELOW TREND — newsflow mixed vs price weakness, monitor for confirmation. UNH (+55): UnitedHealth (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +7.61%) CORRECTION — settlement news confirms partial strength, watch follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): Oracle (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND — negative filing and job cuts confirm selling pressure. NFLX (-45): Netflix (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -18.45%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines aligning with steep declines. BA (-55 bullish earlier but also in mixed news): Boeing (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND — contract news offsets operational headlines, price still weak.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across names (FCX, UNH, LLY et al.) plus bearish Tech sentiment (ORCL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation.
